reason: Batch 003 source audit removed unsupported parking-structure geometry locators. PD 1096 Rule VII supports slot/loading sizes and plan indication; BP 344 supports accessible parking details. Rule XIX, Section 803, and Section 904 are not parking geometry locators.

proposed.text: Under PD 1096 Rule VII, what is the source-backed parking/loading/unloading slot size for a jeepney or shuttle?
proposed.rationale: PD 1096 Rule VII supports 3.00 m x 9.00 m for jeepney or shuttle parking/loading/unloading slots.
proposed.explanation: The old vehicle-ramp calculation used an unsupported local-source premise.
proposed.code_citation: PD 1096 2004 Revised IRR, Rule VII parking/loading slot requirements
